cases.title: Operator runs doctor to verify repo health (self or adopter)

mainFlow.action: Operator runs `devai doctor --self|--adopter|--auto --format human` (Phase 21.B)
Doctor walks the workspace, F1 substrate paths, schemas, constitution pointer, agent sync, chain dir, evidence chain, LLM bridges
Operator reads the OK/FAIL summary and acts on flagged checks

cases.title: Operator bootstraps DEVAI under a target repo

mainFlow.action: Operator runs `devai init plan` to build the role-separated bootstrap plan (deny-by-default on existing files)
Owner and Architect review the plan, invoke their separate `devai init apply-* --as-role <role> --write` segments, then the Architect materializes policy with `devai adopt upgrade --write`

cases.title: Architect resolves which stack-adapter pack matches the adopter repo

mainFlow.action: Architect runs `devai adopt pack resolve --adopter-root <repo>` and reads the matched pack id
Architect tunes `extractor_params` in the matched pack to fit the adopter's directory shape

cases.title: Architect runs first-introspection on a brownfield adopter

mainFlow.action: Architect runs each sense verb in turn: `sense api`, `sense routes`, `sense data-model`, `sense data-handling`, `sense dep-graph`, `sense rbac`, `sense coverage`
Architect calls `inv suggest --from-inventory` to propose INV-CANDIDATE records bridging brownfield to spec
Architect graduates candidates to invariants under `docs/arch/invariants/`

cases.title: Owner authors a module-blueprint; Engineer scaffolds it

mainFlow.action: Owner authors a `module-blueprint.json` under `docs/arch/blueprints/`
Architect validates: `devai spec blueprint validate <path>`
Architect plans: `devai spec blueprint plan <path>` (deterministic scaffold plan, no file writes)
Engineer scaffolds via `skill run SKILL-scaffold-<axis>` and reviews the rendered output

cases.title: Auditor computes the F×T scorecard and assesses repo state

mainFlow.action: Auditor runs `devai govern score compute --readings-dir .devai/state/sensor-readings/ --format human` to compute the scorecard
Auditor optionally passes `--scorecard-na <path>` to apply per-repo N/A carve-outs (Phase 34.B)
Auditor runs `devai govern score assess <scorecard-file>` to generate a narrative assessment with per-cell-class advice (Phase 22.F / 23.I)

cases.title: Engineer drives an autonomous loop iteration end-to-end

mainFlow.action: Engineer adds a backlog entry: `devai work backlog add ...`
Engineer runs `devai experimental loop run --max-iterations 1 --llm-timeout-ms <ms>` (Phase 24.C / 25.C)
Loop acquires locks, spawns a worktree, provisions a per-task DB, runs SKILL-feedback-iteration via the LLM bridge
Engineer reviews the iteration's evidence, completes or escalates the task

cases.title: Auditor verifies the hash-chained evidence ledger

mainFlow.action: Auditor runs `devai evidence chain verify` to confirm chain integrity (Article 32)
Auditor runs `devai evidence chain head` to record the current head hash

cases.title: Operator gates a release on scorecard + invariant state

mainFlow.action: Operator runs `devai release gate --scorecard <path>` to compute a deploy-gate decision (Phase 11.B)
On PASS: deploy; on FAIL: gate rejects, operator addresses the failing cell(s)

cases.title: Inspector audits a PR for unjustified test weakening

mainFlow.action: Inspector runs `devai sense test weakening --base-ref main` against the PR's changed test files
Inspector reviews the SensorReading findings: assertion drops, .skip additions, INV-* removals

cases.title: Operator monitors sensor wall-clock latency against the framework p95 SLO

mainFlow.action: Operator runs `pnpm test:perf` (or `node scripts/perf-bench.mjs`) to benchmark the 7 L0 inventory sensors against a synthetic fixture across 5 samples after warm-up; emits a JSON metrics line with p50_ms + p95_ms.

Operator inspects the emitted `perf_test` SensorReading; the cell is graded PASS / REVIEW / FAIL against the latency thresholds (default pass: p95_ms ≤ 1500ms; review: p95_ms ≤ 3000ms). The 1500ms p95 SLO derives from the Phase 19.C / 26.L performance smoke baseline (stynx-class adopter repos: ~17 packages, ~10k LOC).

If p95 exceeds the threshold, operator investigates the slow sensor's evidence (sensor `duration_ms` per sample, hashed input, configuration drift) and either tunes thresholds in pack config or files a perf-class invariant against the regressed sensor.
